climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, hot summer

blurb.text: A northern Virginia Piedmont AVA in Fauquier and Loudoun counties, D.C. It is ringed by the Potomac River and several mountain ranges. Its distinguishing features are climate, topography, geology and soils.
